decision_notes: Thresholds manually reviewed using the IL17 v2 resequenced QC distributions. The RNA minimum was reduced from 500 to 300 because 90.8% of nuclei with 300-499 RNA UMIs passed the feature requirement, 94.7% passed the mitochondrial requirement, 100% were classified as singlets, and 73.4% passed all other evaluated criteria; this retained 583 additional nuclei before relaxation of the ATAC minimum. The ATAC minimum was reduced from 1000 to 500 because nuclei with 500-999 ATAC counts had a median TSS enrichment of 8.05, 99.5% passed the TSS requirement, 99.3% passed FRiP, 100% passed nucleosome signal, and 93.3% were classified as singlets; this retained 457 additional nuclei after applying the 300-RNA minimum. The common 250-feature minimum and the sample-aware upper RNA and feature limits were retained, while 100000 ATAC counts and the mitochondrial, TSS, nucleosome-signal, and FRiP thresholds remain broad quality bounds.

Thresholds manually reviewed using the IL17 v2 resequenced QC distributions. The RNA minimum was reduced from 500 to 300 because 87.1% of nuclei with 300-499 RNA UMIs passed the initial feature requirement, 96.9% passed the mitochondrial requirement, 100% were classified as singlets, and 76.9% passed all other evaluated criteria; this retained 196 additional nuclei before relaxation of the ATAC minimum. The RNA-feature minimum was reduced from the automated suggestion of 272 to the shared value of 250; only 13 additional nuclei passed all other criteria, giving a negligible 0.22% change while providing a common minimum across IL17 libraries. The ATAC minimum was reduced from 1000 to 500 because nuclei with 500-999 ATAC counts had a median TSS enrichment of 8.51, 99.6% passed the TSS requirement, 97.5% passed FRiP, 100% passed nucleosome signal, and 95.4% were classified as singlets; this retained 241 additional nuclei after applying the 300-RNA minimum. The sample-aware upper RNA and feature limits were retained, while 100000 ATAC counts and the mitochondrial, TSS, nucleosome-signal, and FRiP thresholds remain broad quality bounds.
